description.zh: 仲裁虚拟交换机ID，交换机需位于**ArbiterZoneId**对应的可用区下。
description.en: The vSwitch ID of the arbitration zone. The vSwitch must be in the zone specified by **ArbiterZoneId**.

description.zh: 仲裁可用区ID。
description.en: The zone ID of the arbitration zone.

description.zh: 部署架构的版本，目前仅支持hbaseue引擎类型，取值为**2.0**。
description.en: The version of the deployment architecture. Currently, only the hbaseue engine type is supported. Set the value to **2.0**.

description.zh:
设置实例自动续费周期，单位为月。 >
  • 自动续费周期默认值为0，表示实例到期后不自动续费。
  • 例如自动续费周期设置为2，表示实例到期后自动续费2个月。
description.en:
The auto-renewal period of the instance. Unit: months. >
  • The default value is 0, which indicates that the instance is not automatically renewed after the instance expires.
  • For example, if the auto-renewal period is set to 2, the instance is automatically renewed for two months after the instance expires.

description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value. Make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The value cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters in length and cannot contain non-ASCII characters.

description.zh:
集群名称，设置规则如下：

- 长度为2~128个字符。
- 以大小写字母或中文开头。
- 可包含数字或者特殊字符，特殊字符包括半角句号（.）、短横线（-）和下划线（_）。
description.en:
The cluster name. The following rules apply:

- The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length.
- The name must start with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, or a Chinese character.
- The name can contain digits or special characters, including periods (.), hyphens (-), and underscores (_).

description.zh: 节点磁盘大小，范围为400~64000 GB，步长为40 GB。
description.en: The disk size of the node. Valid values: 400 to 64000. Unit: GB. The value must be a multiple of 40.

description.zh:
core磁盘类型，取值：
- **cloud_efficiency**：高效云盘。
- **cloud_ssd**：SSD云盘。
- **local_hdd_pro**：吞吐密集型本地盘。
- **local_ssd_pro**：I/O密集型本地盘。
description.en:
The disk type of the core node. Valid values:
- **cloud_efficiency**: ultra cloud disk.
- **cloud_ssd**: standard SSD.
- **local_hdd_pro**: throughput-intensive local disk.
- **local_ssd_pro**: I/O-intensive local disk.

description.zh: core节点规格，可调用[DescribeInstanceType](~~145796~~)接口获取。
description.en: The node specifications of the core node. You can invoke the [DescribeInstanceType](~~145796~~) operation to query the node specifications.

description.zh: Core节点个数，Core节点个数取值范围为2~20，且增量为2的倍数。
description.en: The number of core nodes. Valid values: 2 to 20. The value must be an even number.

description.zh: 服务类型，目前仅支持HBase增强版，取值为**hbaseue**。
description.en: The service type. Currently, only ApsaraDB for HBase Performance-enhanced Edition is supported. Set the value to **hbaseue**.

description.zh: 引擎类型的版本号，取值为**2.0**。
description.en: The version of the engine type. Set the value to **2.0**.

description.zh: log节点磁盘大小，范围为400~64000 GB，步长为40 GB。
description.en: The disk size of the log node. Valid values: 400 to 64000. Unit: GB. The value must be a multiple of 40.

description.zh:
log节点磁盘类型, 取值：
- **cloud_efficiency**：高效云盘。
- **cloud_ssd**：SSD云盘。
- **local_hdd_pro**：吞吐密集型本地盘。
- **local_ssd_pro**：I/O密集型本地盘。
description.en:
The disk type of the log node. Valid values:
- **cloud_efficiency**: ultra cloud disk.
- **cloud_ssd**: standard SSD.
- **local_hdd_pro**: throughput-intensive local disk.
- **local_ssd_pro**: I/O-intensive local disk.

description.zh: log节点规格， 可调用[DescribeInstanceType](~~145796~~)接口获取。
description.en: The node specifications of the log node. You can invoke the [DescribeInstanceType](~~145796~~) operation to query the node specifications.

description.zh: log节点数量，log节点个数取值范围为4~400，且为4的倍数。
description.en: The number of log nodes. Valid values: 4 to 400. The value must be a multiple of 4.

description.zh: master节点规格， 可调用[DescribeInstanceType](~~145796~~)接口获取。
description.en: The node specifications of the master node. You can invoke the [DescribeInstanceType](~~145796~~) operation to query the node specifications.

description.zh:
<props="china">可用区组合。目前支持如下，可用区组合支持情况可前往售卖页或者通过[DescribeMultiZoneAvailableRegions](~~203039~~)接口查看。</props>
<props="intl">可用区组合。目前支持如下，可用区组合支持情况可前往售卖页查看。</props>
description.en:
<props="china">The zone combination. The following combinations are supported. You can go to the buy page or call the [DescribeMultiZoneAvailableRegions](~~203039~~) operation to view the supported zone combinations.</props>
<props="intl">The zone combination. The following combinations are supported. You can go to the buy page to view the supported zone combinations.</props>.

description.zh:
实例的付费类型，取值：

- **Prepaid**：包年包月（预付费）。
- **Postpaid**：按量付费（后付费）。
description.en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

- **Prepaid**: subscription.
- **Postpaid**: pay-as-you-go.

description.zh:
包年包月实例的购买时长，取值：

- 当PeriodUnit为year时，取值范围为1~3。
- 当PeriodUnit为month时，取值范围为1~9。

> 仅当实例的付费类型为Prepaid时，需要填写此参数。
description.en:
The subscription duration of the subscription instance. Valid values:

- If PeriodUnit is set to year, valid values are 1 to 3.
- If PeriodUnit is set to month, valid values are 1 to 9.

> This parameter is required only when PayType is set to Prepaid.

description.zh:
包年包月实例的购买单位，取值：

- **year**：年。
- **month**：月。

> 仅当实例的付费类型为Prepaid时，需要填写此参数。
description.en:
The unit of the subscription duration for the subscription instance. Valid values:

- **year**
- **month**

> This parameter is required only when PayType is set to Prepaid.

description.zh: 主可用区实例的虚拟交换机ID，必须在**PrimaryZoneId**对应的可用区下。
description.en: The vSwitch ID of the primary zone instance. The vSwitch must be in the zone specified by **PrimaryZoneId**.

description.zh: 主可用区实例的可用区ID。
description.en: The zone ID of the primary zone instance.

description.zh: 实例所属的地域ID，可调用[DescribeRegions](~~144489~~)接口获取。
description.en: The ID of the region in which the instance resides. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~144489~~) operation to query the region ID.

description.zh:
添加实例的白名单IP地址，多个白名单IP地址之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。

> 如果IP地址设置为127.0.0.1，表示禁止所有地址访问该实例。例如IP地址为192.168.0.0/24表示允许所有192.168.0.XX的IP地址访问该实例。
description.en:
The IP addresses in the whitelist of the instance. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,).

> If the IP address is set to 127.0.0.1, all addresses are denied access to the instance. For example, 192.168.0.0/24 indicates that all IP addresses in the 192.168.0.XX range are allowed to access the instance.

description.zh: 备可用区实例的虚拟交换机ID，必须在**StandbyZoneId**对应的可用区下。
description.en: The vSwitch ID of the secondary zone instance. The vSwitch must be in the zone specified by **StandbyZoneId**.

description.zh: 备可用区实例的可用区ID。
description.en: The zone ID of the secondary zone instance.

description.zh: 专有网络ID，必须在**RegionId**所在的地域下。
description.en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC). The VPC must be in the region specified by **RegionId**.

title.zh: 评估是否存在可用资源

example.unifiedCli: aliyun hbase evaluate-multi-zone-resource --engine hbaseue --engine-version 2.0 --arch-version 2.0 --cluster-name hbaseue_test --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpc-id vpc-bp120k6ixs4eog00000 --multi-zone-combination cn-hangzhou-bef-aliyun-com --primary-zone-id cn-hangzhou-e --primary-vswitch-id vsw-hangxzhouxe00000 --standby-zone-id cn-hangzhou-f --standby-vswitch-id vsw-hangxzhouxf0000 --arbiter-zone-id cn-hangzhou-b --arbiter-vswitch-id vsw-hangxzhouxb0000 --master-instance-type hbase.sn1.medium --core-instance-type hbase.sn1.medium --core-disk-type cloud_ssd --core-disk-size 400 --core-node-count 4 --log-instance-type hbase.sn1.medium --log-disk-type cloud_ssd --log-disk-size 400 --log-node-count 4 --security-ip-list 127.0.0.1 --pay-type Postpaid --period-unit month --period 1 --auto-renew-period 0 --client-token f4g8t5rd2gr940000 --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
